answer: The AI agent economy employs a Proof-of-Work identity mechanism where agents must expend computational effort to join the network, creating a canyon of cryptographic difficulty. An attacker attempting a Sybil attack must forge vast numbers of these identities, but each forged identity requires solving puzzles akin to cracking a walnut while crossing a river; the immense resource drain of this brute-force effort ensures the attacker loses far more than any bogus agents could ever earn.
